title: Private Online Prediction from Experts with Small Losses
abstract: arXiv:2610.29575v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider online prediction from experts, a fundamental problem in machine learning, under differential privacy constraints. Existing private algorithms achieve near-optimal regret $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$, where $T$ is the time horizon. However, this bound becomes suboptimal when $L^\star$, the cumulative loss of the best expert, is significantly less than $T$. In this work, we present the first differentially private algorithm with regret $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{L^\star})$, offering a substantial improvement in the low-loss regime. Our regret bound matches the non-private lower bound up to poly-logarithmic factors for constant privacy parameters, demonstrating that privacy incurs only a small cost in this setting. Our result assumes that the input sequence is oblivious, i.e., it is fixed in advance and independent of the algorithm's outputs. We also prove that an $\tilde{\Omega}(\sqrt{T})$ regret is inevitable for adaptively generated inputs,

translated_title: 小损失下的差分隐私专家在线预测
translated_abstract: 我们研究机器学习中的一个基本问题——差分隐私约束下的专家在线预测。现有的隐私保护算法实现了接近最优的遗憾度 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$，其中 $T$ 为时间范围。然而，当最优专家的累计损失 $L^\star$ 远小于 $T$ 时，该界限变得次优。在这项工作中，我们提出了首个遗憾度为 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{L^\star})$ 的差分隐私算法，在低损失情形下带来了显著的改进。对于常数隐私参数，我们的遗憾度界限在多对数因子范围内与非隐私下界相匹配，表明在此设置下隐私只需付出很小的代价。我们的结果假设输入序列是忘却的，即预先固定且独立于算法的输出。我们还证明了对于自适应生成的输入，$\tilde{\Omega}(\sqrt{T})$ 的遗憾度是不可避免的。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个遗憾度达到 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{L^\star})$ 的差分隐私专家在线预测算法，在低损失情形下显著优于现有 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ 界限，并证明在忘却输入下隐私代价很小。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first differentially private algorithm for online prediction from experts achieving $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{L^\star})$ regret, substantially improving upon the $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ bound in the low-loss regime and demonstrating that privacy incurs only a small cost for oblivious inputs.
